notes: 1.50.12: fixes the real Production cause of 1.50.11's Markdown bug - phf-ai-engine.js/phf-ai-sandbox.css are loaded via a hand-written ?v= tag in index.html (immutable 1yr cache), not the build-info.json runtime loader, so the browser kept serving the pre-hotfix files under an unchanged URL; ?v= bumped and both files added to the manual-asset-tag release gate so this can't recur silently. Markdown-lite renderer extended with horizontal rule (---), italic (*/_), fenced code blocks, and lightweight headings (rendered as bold text, not real h1-h6, to keep the chat bubble from looking like a document). SYSTEM_PROMPT tightened for natural conversational UX: no throat-clearing openers, length scales with question complexity, evidence/analysis labeling only when it actually matters (not on every sentence), tool-calling mechanics hidden from user-facing wording, no raw error dumps.
